data.name: GCR3 Geoff Crammond
data.detailed_description:
Geoff Crammond Racing 3 (GCR3)

Geoff Crammond Racing 3 is a faithful revival of one of the most acclaimed racing simulators of its time, brought back by MicroProse and Geoff Crammond.

GCR3 delivers a refined and immersive racing experience, with deep simulation mechanics, realistic car behaviour, and a full season of high-stakes open-wheel competition.

Drive precision-engineered racing machines across a global circuits—each inspired by famous tracks. Players can rename any tracks or team to make the experience their own and share via Steam Workshop.

Key Features:

  • Advanced Driving Simulation – Realistic physics model, responsive handling, and detailed environmental conditions.

  • Full Race Weekend – Practice, qualifying, and race sessions with strategic depth.

  • Dynamic AI Opponents – Computer-controlled drivers that make mistakes, defend positions, and challenge your skills.

  • Detailed Car Setup – Fine-tune gear ratios, suspension, aerodynamics, and more.

  • Championship Mode – Compete through a full season of races to claim the top spot.

  • Steam Workshop Support – Customize teams, drivers, and track names. Easily rename any element to reflect your own racing universe.

  • Replay System & Data Tools – Analyze your laps and review races with replay and telemetry features.

  • Realistic Racing Simulation: Experience authentic racing with accurate car handling and physics.

  • Customizable Teams and Drivers: Rename drivers, teams, and tracks to create your own fictional or historically inspired championship.

  • Dynamic Weather System: Race-changing weather conditions that affect race strategy and performance.

  • Detailed Tracks: Explore many meticulously recreated circuits from around the globe.

Geoff Crammond Racing 3 is the ultimate racing simulation, capturing the essence of late 1990s open-wheel racing. Designed for both casual gamers and hardcore racing enthusiasts, this game offers an unparalleled experience that combines realism, strategy, and adrenaline-pumping action.

Feel the rush as you take control of your favourite car, complete with customisable liveries and driver names. The game features customisable teams, tracks, and drivers.

With nostalgic graphics pushing the era's limits, every circuit is brought to life with detail, from the iconic tracks to the challenging Spa-Francorchamps. The advanced physics engine,  ensures that every turn, acceleration, and braking maneuver feels realistic, providing a true-to-life racing experience.

One of the standout features of Geoff Crammond Racing 3 is its dynamic weather system. Experience the unpredictability of rain-soaked tracks or the strategic challenges posed by changing weather conditions. Adapt your racing strategy on the fly, choosing the right tires and pit strategies to gain an edge over your competitors.

Customization is key in Geoff Crammond Racing 3. Fine-tune your car's setup to match your driving style and the specific demands of each track. Adjust the suspension, aerodynamics, and tire pressure to optimize performance and gain that crucial advantage.

The game also boasts a sophisticated AI system that learns from your racing style, providing a challenging and engaging experience every time you hit the track. Compete against intelligent opponents who will push you to your limits, making every race a test of skill and strategy.

Whether you’re a seasoned veteran of racing games or a newcomer eager to experience the thrill of Geoff Crammond Racing 3, the game delivers an unforgettable racing experience that will keep you coming back for more. Get ready to buckle up and take on the world of Racing!

GCR3 captures the essence of pure simulation racing, returning with enhanced compatibility and full support for community modding. Whether you're chasing lap times or battling wheel-to-wheel, Geoff Crammond Racing 3 brings back the glory of true sim racing.

data.short_description: Geoff Crammond Racing 3 revives a classic era of open-wheel racing with authentic physics, full race weekends, and strategic depth. Compete across a season of iconic circuits, fine-tune your setup, and face dynamic AI rivals. With Steam Workshop support, customize teams, drivers, and tracks.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Later
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce GTX 1070 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce GTX 2060 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
